title: Eglin AFB diamond formation of orbs; Gaetz denied access to crew

tellings.quote: who was basically denied access to a crew that had seen kind of a diamond shaped formation of orbs.

plain: An aircrew at Eglin Air Force Base in Florida saw glowing orbs flying in a diamond-shaped formation, and when Matt Gaetz, a US congressman from Florida, tried to speak with that crew, he was turned away. This comes from a former intelligence officer named David Grusch, who passes on what Gaetz went through. If true, it would mean the military kept even a sitting member of Congress away from witnesses.
